workflows.when: Create/revise a visual direction, implement FE and verify its accepted UX flows.
Reconstruct Work from selected existing source/worktrees and resolve business/architecture.
Create a new Work purpose and deliver business plus architecture.
Design, implement and independently accept a bounded backend API.
Publish and deploy a verified delivery only when both effects are selected.
Deliver exactly three independent BE/FE/UAT pieces with disjoint mutable scope.
Complete one ad hoc job from the request; small fixes, standalone deployments or data corrections may use this workflow.
Create or bind the missing Work workspace within the original request scope, then resume the suspended workflow after user approval.
Resolve current business requirements, then architecture, for an existing valid Work module before delivery.
Implement an accepted architecture sequentially through backend, frontend and UAT.
